correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs all factors using unique residues mod q. Short nonwrapping factors contain a chosen last-symbol occurrence; short wrapping factors are covered by a chosen final-period marker or contain the critical F_r. For long factors, length >=q makes the union of occurrence intervals contiguous and any missed interval forces the exact exceptional choices. The critical factor realizes those conditions. Candidate counting and positivity establish minimum size q and all formulas. The checker independently exhausts 71,426 one-per-letter selections over 80 parameter cells, but is not the infinite proof.
